items.name: Rusty Sword
items.description: It has seen better days, but it is still sharp enough.

items.name: Oak Cudgel
items.description: A knobbly club of seasoned oak. Simple and honest.

items.name: Hunting Bow
items.description: A light yew bow, good for wolves and boars.

items.name: Iron Sword
items.description: A soldier's sword, plain and reliable.

items.name: Cutlass
items.description: A sailor's curved sword, quick in close quarters.

items.name: Thornlash
items.description: A whip of briar that stings like a nettle patch.

items.name: Ember Spear
items.description: Its tip glows like a coal pulled from the forge.

items.name: Icicle Dagger
items.description: A blade of ice that never melts, even in summer.

items.name: Spark Rapier
items.description: A thin, fizzing blade. Every thrust crackles.

items.name: Morningstar
items.description: A spiked ball on a chain, blessed at a mountain chapel.

items.name: Viper Fang Dagger
items.description: Its blade drips green venom.

items.name: Flame Blade
items.description: A sword that burns without ever burning out.

items.name: Sunlit Mace
items.description: Blessed by the priests of dawn. Spirits and the dead fear it.

items.name: War Axe
items.description: Heavy, brutal, and very effective.

items.name: Glacier Pick
items.description: A miner's pick carved from blue glacier ice. It bites deep.

items.name: Storm Hammer
items.description: Thunder cracks every time it lands.

items.name: Longbow
items.description: Taller than you are, and it shoots twice as far.

items.name: Scorpion Bow
items.description: A black bow with a stinger for a grip. Its arrows burn with venom.

items.name: Steel Longsword
items.description: Fine dwarven steel with a keen, long edge.

items.name: Inferno Greatsword
items.description: Forged inside a volcano, and it has never cooled down.

items.name: Winter's Edge
items.description: Snow swirls around the blade wherever it goes.

items.name: Tempest Spear
items.description: The wind howls along its shaft. Lightning follows its point.

items.name: Dawnblade
items.description: A sword the colour of sunrise. Darkness shrinks from it.

items.name: Elven Bow
items.description: Silver-strung and feather-light. It never misses.

items.name: Mithril Blade
items.description: Bright as moonlight and lighter than a feather.

items.name: Knight's Blade
items.description: From the Queen's armory. Every knight of Everwyn carries one.

items.name: Captain's Blade
items.description: From the Queen's armory, for those who have saved the kingdom twice.

items.name: Royal Blade
items.description: Gold-hilted and bright. Only the Queen's own champions carry it.

items.name: Frostbrand
items.description: A blade of living ice, made long ago to slay dragons. Its cold never fades.

items.name: Trident of Tides
items.description: The sea obeys whoever holds it. Sea monsters dread it.

items.name: Spellbreaker Staff
items.description: A staff of white ash, blessed at dawn. Every spell it touches unravels.

items.name: Hearthblade
items.description: Forged in a thousand kitchen fires. Its warmth burns away blight and witchery.

items.name: Stormcaller
items.description: A cutlass that calls down squalls. No pirate wants a storm at sea.

items.name: Northwind Spear
items.description: The spear of the old northern kings. Invaders who feel its wind remember the long retreat.

items.name: Giant's Needle
items.description: A long, thin blade dipped in stingnettle. The bigger they are, the more it stings.

items.name: Lightbringer
items.description: A sword of pure sunrise. The dead cannot bear to look at it.

items.name: Goblinsbane
items.description: A sword that throws sparks. Goblins scatter from it like mice from a cat.

items.name: Sunforge Hammer
items.description: Forged in the heart of a volcano, it still glows like a summer noon. Giants fear it.

items.name: Leather Cap
items.description: Better than nothing. Slightly.

items.name: Leather Vest
items.description: Tough boiled leather.

items.name: Iron Helm
items.description: A dented but trusty helmet.

items.name: Oak Shield
items.description: Oak planks bound with iron. It has stopped a lot of arrows.

items.name: Chainmail
items.description: Thousands of tiny rings. Heavy, but blows glance off.

items.name: Traveler's Cloak
items.description: Keeps off the rain and the miles. Travel costs 6% less Energy, until it wears out.

items.name: Boots of Striding
items.description: Enchanted boots. Travel costs 12% less Energy, until they wear out.

items.name: Ring of Vigor
items.description: A warm gold ring. Battle HP +20%.

items.name: Lucky Clover
items.description: A four-leaf clover pressed in glass. +15% gold from battles.

items.name: Wizard's Hat
items.description: Tall, pointy, and humming with power. Potions +20% stronger.

items.name: Gauntlets of Might
items.description: Iron gloves that tighten your grip. Weapon damage +12%.

items.name: Fur Cloak
items.description: Thick wolf fur. Ice attacks do half damage.

items.name: Plague Mask
items.description: Stuffed with herbs. Poison attacks do half damage.

items.name: Storm Charm
items.description: A blue glass eye on a cord. Storm attacks do half damage.

items.name: Salamander Scale
items.description: A fire-lizard's scale on a chain. Fire attacks do half damage.

items.name: Dragonscale Shield
items.description: Forged from a dead wyrm's scales. Fire attacks do half damage.

items.name: Selkie Cloak
items.description: Woven from seal-fur by the selkies. The cold of the deep can't touch you.

items.name: Warding Amulet
items.description: Beads of rowan and silver. Lightning bends away from whoever wears them.

items.name: Physician's Mantle
items.description: A long waxed coat and a hood full of sweet herbs. The plague can't find a way in.

items.name: Admiral's Coat
items.description: Navy wool with anchor buttons, soaked in seawater. Cannon-fire slides right off.

items.name: Bulwark Shield
items.description: A tall shield faced with wet hides. Fire arrows fizzle out against it.

items.name: Lodestone Belt
items.description: Lodestones on a leather belt. Lightning runs into the ground instead of into you.

items.name: Emberheart Amulet
items.description: Warm as a hearth, and it never cools. The chill of the grave can't reach your heart.

items.name: Boarhide Jerkin
items.description: Tough as old boots and twice as smelly. Poisoned goblin darts just bounce off.

items.name: Emberweave Cloak
items.description: Woven from fire-moth silk. Snow melts before it touches you.

items.name: Healing Draught
items.description: Tastes of mint and honey. Restores 35% of your HP in battle.

items.name: Greater Healing Draught
items.description: Deep red and fizzing. Restores 70% of your HP in battle.

items.name: Fire Flask
items.description: Throw it and step back. Deals fire damage.

items.name: Frost Flask
items.description: Freezing cold to the touch. Deals ice damage — and cools a fever.

items.name: Thunder Vial
items.description: A captured storm. Deals storm damage.

items.name: Holy Water
items.description: Blessed at the dawn altar. Deals holy damage.

items.name: Venom Vial
items.description: Green, bubbling and very rude. Deals poison damage.

items.name: Potion of Might
items.description: Your muscles swell. Weapon damage ×1.5 for 20 seconds.

items.name: Shield Tonic
items.description: Your skin turns tough as bark. +40% armor for 20 seconds.

items.name: Quickening Elixir
items.description: Everything slows but you. Strike 60% faster for 15 seconds.

items.name: Traveler's Tonic
items.description: Drink it on the road: the rest of the trip costs 20% less Energy.

items.name: Tome of Might
items.description: Read it once and your arm never forgets. Strength +1.

items.name: Tome of Arcana
items.description: Secrets of the old mages. Magic +1.

items.name: Tome of Vigor
items.description: Exercises from the knights' academy. Vigor +1.

items.name: Tome of Fortune
items.description: A gambler's memoirs. Luck +1.

items.name: Rusty Key
items.description: An old iron key, orange with rust.

items.name: Shrine Key
items.description: A bronze key, green with swamp-damp, its bow carved like a wave.

items.name: Tower Key
items.description: A long black key with a tiny tower for a bow.

items.name: Crypt Key
items.description: A cold key of grey iron. It hums faintly when you hold it.

items.name: Vault Key
items.description: A heavy brass key stamped with a crown.

items.name: Cellar Key
items.description: A stubby key that smells of apples and damp.

items.name: Gate Key
items.description: A great iron key, as long as your forearm.

items.name: Sea-Chest Key
items.description: A green copper key on a knotted cord.

items.name: Sealed Letter
items.description: A letter sealed with a wax wheat-sheaf.

items.name: Silver Bell
items.description: Millbrook's flood-bell, a little dented.

items.name: Bundle of Healing Herbs
items.description: A fragrant bundle of feverfew and willow bark.

items.name: Ore Sample
items.description: A chunk of rock laced with bright silver.

items.name: Wedding Cake
items.description: Three tiers, sugar roses, and strict instructions not to eat any.

items.name: Bundle of Sea Charts
items.description: A roll of sea charts tied with red ribbon and sealed twice.

items.name: Prize Pumpkin
items.description: The biggest pumpkin anyone has ever seen, bound for the harvest fair.

items.name: Book of Songs
items.description: Old songs copied out by hand, with the tunes drawn in the margins.

items.name: Sack of Seed Grain
items.description: Next year's harvest, in a sack. Keep it dry.

items.name: Love Letter
items.description: It smells of lavender. You are absolutely not going to read it.

items.name: Basket of Kittens
items.description: Three kittens in a basket, looking for a new home. One of them is chewing your sleeve.

items.name: Bolt of Blue Cloth
items.description: Fine blue wool, dyed with woad, for a festival banner.

items.name: Sack of Nails
items.description: Enough nails to rebuild a barn. Heavy, and it clanks.

items.name: Town Charter
items.description: An old parchment with the town's rights on it, signed by a queen long ago.

items.name: Golden Egg
items.description: Laid by the most famous goose in the valley. It really is gold.

items.name: Mill Gear
items.description: A wooden cog from a water-mill, worn smooth by the years.

items.name: Harvest Cup
items.description: The prize of the harvest fair, engraved with forty years of winners.

items.name: Brass Spyglass
items.description: The harbour master's spyglass, with a dent where someone sat on it.

items.name: Weather Rooster
items.description: A copper rooster from the top of a steeple. It points into the wind.

items.name: Lost Lute
items.description: A minstrel's lute with a ribbon on its neck. One string is out of tune.

items.name: Temple Wind-Chime
items.description: Glass chimes that ring even when there is no wind.

items.name: Tidestone
items.description: A sea-blue stone, always cool. It drinks fire the way sand drinks water.

items.name: Siren's Conch
items.description: Blow it and the sea goes still. Even a kraken has to listen.

items.name: Mirror of Truth
items.description: Hold it up and every illusion breaks. A curse cannot bear its own reflection.

items.name: Heartroot
items.description: A root from the first oak in the world. Brewed in water, it cures any blight.

items.name: Map of Skull Cove
items.description: Shows the one safe channel through the reefs to the pirates' hidden cove.

items.name: Queen's Banner
items.description: Queen Isolde's own standard. Wherever it flies, the people of Everwyn stand and fight.

items.name: Lullaby Horn
items.description: Its note is so soft and sleepy that even a giant yawns.

items.name: Candle of Dawn
items.description: It burns with morning light. Where it shines, the dead lie still.

items.name: Sunstone
items.description: A stone full of trapped sunlight. Goblins can't stand to look at it.

items.name: Heart of Summer
items.description: A sunflower that never wilts, with a whole summer inside it.

items.name: Jar of Honey
items.description: Golden Millbrook honey. Sweet enough to bribe a hermit.

items.name: Wheel of Cheese
items.description: A whole wheel of sharp hill cheese. It smells magnificent.

items.name: Apple Pie
items.description: Still warm, with a lattice top. Hard to carry without nibbling.

items.name: Bag of Toffee
items.description: Chewy, buttery, and very bad for your teeth.

items.name: Pair of Knitted Socks
items.description: Thick, striped, and the warmest socks in the kingdom.

items.name: Smoked Fish
items.description: Golden, salty and smoky. Cats follow you everywhere.

items.name: Tin of Spiced Tea
items.description: A tin of tea with cinnamon and orange peel, from far across the sea.

items.name: Silk Ribbon
items.description: A spool of shimmering silk ribbon, the colour of a sunset.

items.name: Wolf Pelt
items.description: A thick grey pelt. Furriers pay well.

items.name: Goblin Trinket
items.description: Goblins love shiny junk. So do some shopkeepers.

items.name: Eagle Feather
items.description: A long, barred feather. Fletchers pay well for these.

items.name: Sea Glass
items.description: A pebble of blue glass, polished smooth by the waves.

items.name: Spider Silk
items.description: A skein of silk stronger than rope. Tailors fight over it.

items.name: Pirate Doubloon
items.description: A heavy gold coin stamped with a skull.

items.name: Troll Tooth
items.description: Huge, yellow, and faintly smelly. Alchemists want these.

items.name: Carved Tusk
items.description: An old tusk carved with running deer.

items.name: Frost Lily
items.description: A white flower that blooms only in snow. Perfumers pay a fortune.

items.name: Silver Ore
items.description: Heavy rock with fat veins of silver.

items.name: Crystal Shard
items.description: A shard of cave crystal that rings when you tap it.

items.name: Pearl
items.description: A perfect pearl, pink as dawn.

items.name: Ember Crystal
items.description: It glows like a coal and is warm in your hand.

items.name: Golden Idol
items.description: A grinning little god of solid gold.
